Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying Qs so we can move toward sizing:

- Our main use case: real-time product personalization (recommendations + short-format creative) called from our API.
- Target traffic: steady-state ~120 TPS, peak bursts up to ~350 TPS for 2–3 minutes.
- Typical payloads: prompt ~50 tokens, model response ~180 tokens (avg ~230 tokens per request).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 300ms if possible; 99th < 600ms is acceptable.
- Security: SOC2 required, likely will need Private VPC for production but open to Dedicated to start.

Questions:
1) Which GPU would you recommend for steady 120 TPS with those token numbers (A100 vs H100)?
2) How many dedicated nodes would we need to cover steady + burst with room for headroom?
3) Any recommendations on concurrency / batching settings to hit the latency SLO?

We attached our rough QPS trace and sample payloads; happy to jump on a short follow-up with your engineer.

Thanks,
Sam Brooks

Hi team — following up with a sizing-first-pass based on the numbers Sam provided. TL;DR recommendation: H100-backed Dedicated cluster with autoscale headroom (hybrid burst) for your burst profile. Details: 

Assumptions:
- Avg tokens per request: 230
- Steady-state: 120 TPS continuous
- Burst: 350 TPS for ~3 minutes
- Model: high-capacity open model (LLamaX-70B-ish) or equivalently sized model that benefits from H100 memory/throughput

GPU recommendation:
- H100 preferred for high throughput and better mixed-precision performance vs A100 for this token mix and latency targets. H100 also gives more headroom for larger KV caches for your personalization context.

Node sizing (estimate):
- Baseline (steady 120 TPS): ~6 x H100 nodes (with continuous batching, warm KV cache). This assumes per-node inference throughput ~20 TPS at 230 tokens/request with optimized kernels and batching.
- Burst capacity to 350 TPS: add autoscale/burst pool of ~12 additional H100 nodes (scheduled burst or on-demand) — total peak ~18 nodes. If you prefer reserved-only, we would size for peak (18 nodes) and tune autoscaling policies to keep costs down.

Concurrency / batching guidance:
- Target per-worker concurrency: 8–12 concurrent requests (depends on prompt variability).
- Internal batch sizes: smallish batches (8–16) to keep 95p latency < 300ms; continuous batching + KV cache should keep effective latency low.
- For tail-latency, enable request prioritization for critical endpoints and reduce max batch wait to 15–25ms.

Memory / cache notes:
- Plan for ~40–50GB of KV cache capacity per node for personalization contexts; H100 memory and NVLink helps here.

Latency projections (95p):
- With H100 + continuous batching tuned as above, expect 95th ~180–280ms at steady 120 TPS. During bursts, if autoscale brings nodes up within 90–120s, 95p can remain <350ms; otherwise latency will spike until new instances are warm.

Migration to Private VPC:
- Dedicated -> Private path is straightforward: same runtime and configs, but we provision control plane connectivity and customer-managed networking. We recommend piloting on Dedicated for 4–8 weeks to validate traffic patterns before finalizing Private sizing.

Next steps:
1) Sam / Emily: confirm the worksheet numbers and any additional high-priority endpoints.
2) Marissa: I’ll prepare two sizing options (steady-only reserved + reserved-with-burst) with cost estimates and expected warm-up times.

Happy to hop on a 30m call if you want to walk through the worksheet.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
